problem: Airlines overbook and miss post-booking revenue; Volantio's Yana platform optimizes capacity and ancillary revenue after booking.

technical_complexity.rationale: Pricing and inventory optimization integrated with airline reservation systems.

defensibility.rationale: Deep airline integration and strategic airline investors; long sales cycles.

market_need_then: Airlines back the company strategically and 18+ airlines were customers by 2022 (press release).
outcome_analysis: Volantio, a Winter 2009 company, survived over a decade and grew into airline enterprise software with 18+ customers by 2022, backed by strategic airline investors. Funding was small relative to the time elapsed, so it is a durable niche business rather than a breakout; founder bios and 2009-2017 funding are unknown.
notes: Stage labels are inconsistent: a 2018 round is called Series B and a 2022 round Series A in the sources; labels kept as stated. 2018 details from search summary (Business Wire fetch returned 403, not bypassed). Rounds before 2018 not found. Founder bios not listed on YC. Competitors list empty: no sources dated near the batch were retrieved; as_of is the batch start.
